title: Haunted Missouri Hotel Has a Jesse James Connection
excerpt: Many who have visited a historic Missouri hotel with connections to Jesse James and Harry Truman say they've encountered paranormal entities inside.
content:
There's a historic Missouri hotel that dates back to just after the Civil War which has connections to some of the most famous personalities in the state such as Jesse and Frank James, Harry Truman among others. Current visitors will also tell you that it is full of paranormal encounters that have many believing former residents never left.

I had one of our audience members (thanks, Lora) reach out and let me know about the Commercial Hotel in Osceola, Missouri. It was built around 1868 after a previous hotel at the location was destroyed during the Civil War. There have been stories over the years of shadow figures, voices heard where no human is and unexplained footsteps. The current owners have fully embraced this paranormal reputation.

Reviewers on Airbnb have shared many chilling comments on experiences they've had in the Commercial Hotel:

Melissa: "I definitely did feel a presence. By the hall bathroom upstairs there is a faint smell of really old perfume. It would come and go...we all felt a chill when we walked in the room. A few seconds of being in the room, I got an instant warm feeling on my left shoulder."

Rebecca: "I saw shadows, felt things, and was offered assistance by a spirit to get my water bottle. I also had a stunning EVP session."

What's responsible for the strange experiences many are reporting inside the Commercial Hotel in Osceola? Even without the paranormal stories, the history of this Missouri place is rich. There's no doubt it's becoming a new favorite among the many paranormal groups who are scheduling investigations there.
